assessment_type.question: Is this assessment for permanent incapacity, current incapacity, or temporary incapacity only?
notes: Do not block calculation solely because assessment_type is unknown if the clinician is asking only for GATIOD table scoring.
If user asks about compensation readiness or final award, assessment_type becomes required.

side.question: Which side is affected — left or right?

confirmation.question: Please confirm the extracted findings before I calculate the system-generated PI%.

doctor_recommended_pi.question: Did the doctor recommend a PI% that differs from the system-generated GATIOD value?
notes: If different, request justification and mark clarification status.

global_safety_phrases.insufficient_facts: I cannot calculate a system-generated PI% yet. I need one more required fact: {missing_slot_question}
global_safety_phrases.cannot_map: I cannot safely map this to a GATIOD calculation row yet. Please clarify: {clarification_question}
global_safety_phrases.out_of_scope: This appears outside the covered GATIOD assessment paths I can calculate. I can still help with covered systems such as upper limb, lower limb, spine, respiratory, renal, gastro-digestive, hearing, CNS, and visual assessment.
global_safety_phrases.no_tool_no_pi: I cannot provide a PI% yet because the calculation tool has not been run. Please confirm the extracted findings or provide the missing details.
